title: Join Our Physician Panel — NoteForWork
description: NoteForWork is building a panel of board-certified physicians and nurse practitioners for async telehealth work excuse documentation. Flexible, remote, 1099.
subtitle: We're Hiring
html:
About the Platform

Work excuse documentation,
done right

NoteForWork is a physician-founded async telehealth platform that provides legitimate work and school absence documentation for minor illnesses. Patients complete a structured intake form, a licensed physician reviews it, and a signed note is delivered within 60 minutes.

We were founded by Dr. Manavjeet Sidhu, MD — board-certified Emergency Medicine physician, NYU medical school, UCSF residency. Every physician on our panel meets the same credentialing standard he set.

We are building our panel ahead of our July 2026 launch and are actively recruiting MDs, DOs, and nurse practitioners in our target states.

Compensation

Competitive supplemental income
on your schedule

$10
Per completed review — approve or decline. Payable regardless of outcome.
$20/hr
Availability rate for logged-in scheduled windows, plus $10 per note.
~$200–300/hr
Effective equivalent at 2–3 minutes per review.
Net 15
ACH payment within 15 days of month end. Annual 1099.

Final compensation structure is discussed individually with each selected candidate and documented in the Independent Contractor Agreement.

Scope of Work

Simple, focused,
low-risk documentation

✓ What you do

✓Review structured patient intake forms
✓Approve or decline work and school absence notes
✓Sign physician documentation for minor illness
✓Apply independent clinical judgment

✕ What you don't do

✕No video or phone consultations
✕No prescribing medications
✕No FMLA or disability assessments
✕No modified duty recommendations

High-risk patients are blocked by our automated intake screener before reaching the physician queue. You only review cases that have already passed clinical screening criteria.

Requirements

Who we're looking for

✓Active unrestricted MD, DO, or NP license in one or more of our target states
✓Board certified (MD/DO) or nationally certified NP in a relevant specialty
✓Professional liability insurance — minimum $1M/$3M coverage
✓Clean disciplinary history — no active investigations or board restrictions
✓Not excluded from Medicare, Medicaid, or any federal healthcare program
✓NPs must hold full practice authority in their state to sign independently
✕No active felony charges or healthcare-related criminal history
Common Questions

What physicians ask us

What states are you recruiting in? +
We are recruiting physicians and NPs in California, Texas, Florida, New York, Illinois, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Georgia, Michigan, Washington, Arizona, Colorado, Maryland, Nevada, Oregon, Minnesota, Wisconsin, and many more states. If you hold a license in any US state, reach out — we may be actively recruiting there. We do not currently accept patients from Arkansas, Kansas, Tennessee, or New Mexico.
Can NPs apply? +
Yes — nurse practitioners with full practice authority in their state can sign notes independently on our platform. If you are in a reduced practice authority state and require a collaborating physician, contact us and we can discuss whether a collaboration arrangement is feasible.
How flexible is the schedule? +
Very flexible. You commit to availability windows that work for you — mornings, evenings, overnight, weekends. Our 60-minute guarantee means patients need a physician available during your committed window, but outside those hours you have no obligation. Many of our physicians use this as supplemental income during evenings and weekends.
Do I need to carry my own malpractice insurance? +
Yes. As an independent contractor you are required to carry your own professional liability insurance with a minimum of $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 aggregate. We are exploring group policy options and will update candidates during the onboarding discussion.
What does the application process look like? +
Email us your interest and your license state(s). If there's a fit, we'll send you a link to our online clinical assessment — 7 short patient cases reviewed on your own time, takes about 15 minutes. Dr. Sidhu reviews results and contacts qualified candidates within 5 business days for a brief follow-up call. Selected candidates then complete credentialing and sign the contractor agreement before launch.
Is this employment or a contractor arrangement? +
This is a 1099 independent contractor arrangement. You are not an employee of NoteForWork or Dr. Sidhu's professional corporation. You retain complete clinical independence — the platform never directs your clinical decisions. You are responsible for your own taxes and benefits.

Interested in joining?

Send us a brief email with your name, your medical credential (MD, DO, or NP), and the state or states where you hold an active license. No CV needed at this stage. We'll follow up within 3 business days.
